parts.name: Door Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the door, typically made of wood. It forms the structural panel that opens and closes to allow or restrict access.
parts.Functional_description: The door body provides the main barrier for privacy, security, and insulation. It supports the handle and hinges for operation.
parts.Movement_description: The door body rotates about its hinges to open or close.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the door, made of stainless steel. It is attached to the door body and used for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows users to pull or push the door to open or close it. It may also engage a latch mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or move slightly to actuate the latch mechanism.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the opposite side handle of the door, also made of stainless steel. It mirrors the first handle for operation from the other side.
parts.Functional_description: It provides grip and control for opening or closing the door from the opposite side.
parts.Movement_description: This handle also rotates or moves slightly to operate the latch mechanism.
